entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal layer for managing User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent memory as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system to achieve a 91% token reduction and features observable retrieval trajectories for debugging context paths.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This platform provides agents with persistent long-term memory by building self-hosted knowledge graphs that combine vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning. It supports integration through dedicated Python, Rust, and TypeScript clients.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain synthesizes cited prose across entities and extracts typed knowledge graph edges without requiring LLM calls. It is designed for flexible deployment, including support for serverless environments via PGLite.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that supports sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication with a 100% prompt-cache discount. It automates fact extraction and user profiling while offering connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight enables long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows across more than 25 LLM providers, including local models. The system is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud and offers client libraries for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This FastAPI-based library serves as the upstream foundation for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper, providing reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversation history. It supports managed, local, and Docker Compose deployments with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider manages context trees using git-like versioning, including commit, branch, and merge functionality. It features a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, enabling sub-100ms performance via an interactive TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database for local storage and sub-millisecond performance. It supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration with tools like Cursor and Claude Code through a simple Python SDK.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system uses local infrastructure including Qdrant and Redis to manage persistent memory, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure the agent prioritizes specific injected context during operations.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and context bundles to assist with complex tasks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to validate context changes through Python and TypeScript interfaces.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent uses a DAG-based engine and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized tools for searching and expanding compacted material and requires Python 3.11-3.14.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides Hermes Agent with private cross-session memory persistence. It includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible provider or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI is a local-first identity and memory layer that achieves 97.6% LongMemEval answer accuracy. It enables portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients by importing data from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur utilizes a shared memory layer that stores data as human-readable YAML files on a local disk. It employs a hybrid search strategy combining BM25 and local embeddings to serve MCP-integrated tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks, utilizing hybrid retrieval through BM25 and vector search.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system built on SQLite with FTS5 search, intentionally omitting vector databases and embeddings. The project features a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result. It features contradiction tracking, owner-scoping for multi-user environments, and a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack functions as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets to the agent for each query.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing memory as inspectable Markdown files rather than opaque databases. It is a daemonless system that utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache for coding agents.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and includes an MCP-native server with automated configuration for coding agent clients.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, aiming for a 94% reduction in prompt tokens. It supports MCP-native integration and uses SQLite with FTS5 for local-first persistent memory.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes and supports automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This project reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 using local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard to track estimated schema token savings and supports native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin utilizing a single .lbdb embedded graph database file for storage. It features importance-weighted recall to surface high-priority memories and supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer maintains provider-neutral state, skills, and lifecycle transitions in Markdown. It supports Hermes and other coding agents via selective context imports and manual opt-in integrations.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: An episodic memory plugin for Hermes Agent that implements an on-demand summarizer and supports immediate event deletion. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track all prefetch operations.
entries.piprail/piprail: An SDK and MCP server that enables AI agents, including Hermes, to handle payments via USDC and stablecoins. It supports 29 chains across 10 families and settles payments directly to wallets with 0% transaction fees.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local scripts, runbooks, MCP server configurations, and skills for routing. It provides tools for artifact search, retrieval, and graph neighbor traversal, utilizing feedback to improve routing hints.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A durable cross-session memory provider featuring a local SQLite reliability layer and write outbox. It provides tools for state updates and searching, alongside session-end snapshots and pre-turn context injection.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for result reranking and configurable query expansion.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory solution featuring AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and native Rust FFI or HTTP daemon execution modes. It supports sparse, FM-index, and HNSW ANN retrieval.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories via a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for file reads, sync, and search.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A memory provider offering 17 tools for knowledge graph traversal and memory management. It utilizes hybrid search combining vector, BM25, and graph methods, and performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: A database-free memory hygiene tool that uses a git-backed directory of versioned Markdown files. It includes 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data and provides five slash commands for capture, recall, and curation.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework utilizes a subagent-driven development process to execute tasks autonomously while enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles. It functions as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs, providing a structured methodology for agentic software development.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system for macOS and Windows that generates documents and decks using real CSS and components. It features a coding-agent CLI that supports Hermes Agent and integrates with DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured cybersecurity skills across 34 domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security layer for agent operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool generates draw.io diagrams from natural language descriptions, SQL, or codebase import graphs and synchronizes updates without losing manual style changes. It includes an MCP server and CLI specifically designed for automated architecture reviews.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and payments. It adds a verification and dispute resolution layer to agent interactions by incorporating official protocol skills.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This project audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using five optional voice profiles such as technical or professional. It is compatible with agentskills.io-compliant platforms, including Claude Code and Hermes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This system unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that natively integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and QwenPaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring the collective evolution of agent skills.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with the agent-plugins.org specification. It maintains session state within a project's documentation directory and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,153 professional skills with native support for Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It includes ready-to-paste exports for various assistants and integrations for platforms like Slack, Telegram, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent and other tools to perform video searches, extract transcripts, and browse YouTube channels or playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage new skills via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These pre-built skills convert rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. The workflow features Lite and Full modes for varying project complexity and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill allows agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the original literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Designed for long-running agents, this harness uses a three-layer architecture of kernel, plugins, and recipes to manage work lifecycles and durable decisions. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol to facilitate supervised team coordination.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These interoperable skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable interactions with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. The package includes specialized capabilities for CRE and ACE services within oracle networks and smart contracts.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Brazilian community by providing installation guides and skills in the SKILL.md format in Portuguese. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard to support localized Hermes Agent integrations.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide specialized prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX image and video generation. The project includes a router for managing multi-step video workflows via Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned instruction files compliant with agentskills.io. It links instructions to specific source lines and provides lifecycle tooling for creating, testing, and exporting skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client and CLI, alongside commerce capabilities using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex multi-step tasks with real-time progress and decision tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This local-first workflow language uses a single Rust binary and four verbs to execute AI tasks with hash-chained receipts for verifiable history. It audits cost ceilings, secret flows, and types before spending tokens to ensure secure execution.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system that uses hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token consumption and includes graceful degradation for environments missing specific embedding models.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill browsing and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This ADHD-friendly execution system allows an agent to manage system design while the user completes tasks via a tapping interface. It stores all data locally using SQLite and connects to AI agents specifically through the Model Context Protocol.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram to reduce token usage by up to 80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of three sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports multiple programming languages and employs a risk-tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It utilizes a Python goal engine to maintain persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills provide session management to maintain memory between agent conversations and tools for worktree recovery. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and state drift detection.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repository READMEs using vhs or Playwright. It optimizes files to remain under 8 MB and embeds the rendered output directly into the project documentation.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing specification rot. It validates skills against runtime profiles and monitors official frontmatter specs weekly to detect and report drift.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It gates updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first observability dashboard provides 11 monitoring tabs for tracking Hermes Agent metrics such as token costs, sessions, and errors. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports optional incident alerts via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across native Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and supports OpenClaw and Hermes Agent environments.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill's operational status.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables agents to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with payments settled after human approval.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It produces structured reports with AI-driven analysis and utilizes semantic memory to expand searches based on user interests.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides tools for video-to-text conversion, document OCR, and AI writing refinement for macOS and Linux. The skills are built to be compatible with Hermes Agent and the agentskills.io standard.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills via a hosted MCP server. It allows Hermes Agent and other compatible clients to access structured web data across 31 different platforms.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes, alongside associated development tools. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to ensure access to recent versions.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers scripts and configuration guides for running agent CLIs like Hermes on ARM64 Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for the Antigravity CLI and leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and UI access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: Designed for mobile environments, this tool provides a one-line automated installer to run Hermes Agent within Termux. It supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and integration with both external providers and local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with cloud-native guardrails for single-writer state safety. It supports direct deployments or CRD-based workflows and includes a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android (via Termux) and iOS (via iSH). The deployment supports scheduled tasks through cron jobs and integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project focuses on secure execution by sandboxing Hermes Agent with hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies for web search and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes using REST, CLI, or MCP interfaces. It provides operational oversight through per-agent metrics, cost tracking, and LLM budget caps.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It features hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via sops-nix and systemd EnvironmentFiles.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances from a single web application with RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes to run from a USB drive or any external disk without host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes a researcher team to perform bullish and bearish debates, with final approvals handled by dedicated risk management and portfolio manager agents.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. It supports local or Docker-based deployment and provides multiple interfaces including a Web UI, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages persistent coding agent sessions, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, using tmux for background execution. It facilitates multi-repo workspace management through Git worktrees and provides sandboxing via Docker, Podman, or Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain using the Claude-style MCP protocol. It features HTTP signal detection to manage payment-required states for paid APIs during orchestrated workflows.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture to scale Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams. It implements a task bus pattern for delegation and includes bundled skills for security auditing and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and support for over 23 LLM providers. It features MCP tool integration and provides visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface uses a Kanban board to track autonomous task statuses and review queues for Hermes agents. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, and infrastructure roles using a strict pipeline architecture. A Master Orchestrator manages all routing and coordination between these specialized entities.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents to manage the automated task lifecycle. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for tool handling and features a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates two competing AI companies, each comprising nine autonomous agents, to compete for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution and provides a real-time dashboard to visualize code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080 and 5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling through parallel model querying and synthesis without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool maintains a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that synchronizes automatically as files change to minimize token usage and tool calls. It supports structural extraction for TypeScript, JavaScript, ArkTS, and Python, integrating directly with agents like Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility and 3D visualization dashboard designed to track token consumption across various AI coding agents and IDEs. It allows developers to monitor usage data and submit statistics to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from coding agents while automatically redacting sensitive authentication headers. It provides a self-contained HTML viewer for exported sessions, supporting tools such as Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Cursor.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading agent states directly from terminal interfaces. It supports over 33 tools and features multi-device synchronization to maintain consistent usage data across different machines.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project provides community-driven themes and CLI skins to customize the Hermes terminal user interface. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using YAML-based configurations for aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It facilitates identity registration with human-readable handles and supports commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo functionality to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for various frameworks and includes a plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall. It also offers chat bot integrations for platforms like Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and devops, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing users to switch between default and project-specific configurations. It supports local memories, skills, and custom instructions to ensure agent behavior is tailored to the specific directory context.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a full hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides immediate access to 29 community plugins and is designed to get a production-ready environment running in minutes at zero cost.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that analyzes AI agent configurations and system prompts locally to flag vague tool descriptions or missing stop conditions. It integrates directly with GitHub Actions and Hermes Agent pre-verify hooks to ensure compliance with HERM v1.1 scoring standards.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes by mapping SOUL.md files, skills, and memory archives into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles complex nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool provides passive monitoring and active probing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes performance baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This local-first voice interface adds open-mic functionality and wake-word detection to Hermes Agent without requiring API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages and features adaptive turn-taking, allowing users to interrupt or barge-in during interactions.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed to facilitate online revenue generation, this local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit user approval for any external actions or write operations performed by the agent.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities for managing agent data. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages and provides dedicated tools for adding, deleting, and searching memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with Tauri 2, provides a desktop interface for Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers a unified environment for Windows, macOS, and Linux users to manage multiple agent platforms.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi serves as a local cowork application that integrates Hermes Agent with dozens of external agents and 21 built-in professional assistants. It supports remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms, allowing for a flexible, multi-interface workspace.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web-based interface enables mobile and desktop access to Hermes Agent without a complex build step. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote connections via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This companion application simplifies the Hermes Agent experience through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in a single desktop environment.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This dashboard offers a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and unified configuration for 10 messaging platforms, including Telegram and Discord. It includes local SQLite session storage and detailed usage analytics to track token consumption and execution history.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a 'Swarm Mode' with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task management. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated skills manager to provide a comprehensive development environment.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes Agent and other coding assistants into a desktop, server, or Docker-based application. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed specifically for Mac, this workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for system repair. It includes native views for managing Kanban boards, cron jobs, and session data.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes the Hermes-CN-Core kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports LaTeX and Mermaid rendering while providing dedicated management for MCP tools and memory.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes runtime directly to the active browser context. It features 'Hermes Assist' for site-aware drafting and live browser control with explicit approval gates for automated actions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from an iPhone. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to enable real-time chat, task management, and file system browsing without third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track latency and token usage. It provides a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring real-time code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that attributes live quota burn to individual agent sessions while maintaining local privacy with no telemetry. It supports searchable transcripts for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs, acting as a specialized agent cockpit and analytics tracker.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for interactive agent management.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web-based interface. It features a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative dashboard provides a terminal interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI operates as a Telegram Mini App, supporting background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application requires no installation or admin rights and supports both cloud and local AI models. It includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers alongside built-in support for ComfyUI and workflows.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes a task tracking dashboard and management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard focuses on process transparency by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace that uses real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards to manage agent interactions. It features an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client features a PM orchestrator to manage collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It includes a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
